intent: Add provider-specific registration tabs in ADL while preserving Ollama setup and preventing unsupported registrations from appearing live-ready.

features.assertion: Provider settings exposes provider-specific tabs and registration methods for the catalogued providers.
Registrations persist without returning API key material and remain marked unverified until an actual provider check exists.
Existing Ollama status, configuration, model listing, and non-generative verification controls remain available.

tests.expected: Frontend type-check and production bundle succeed.
Each provider tab shows its own registration methods and selected-state semantics.
Registration create/read persists expected status and method for allowed provider IDs.
Secrets are accepted only by write-only fields, not written to JSON, and never returned by status responses.
Existing Ollama setup behavior remains available and unchanged.

standard_first.justification: Adapt the BAGO provider registration presets and the ADL provider settings flow while using ADL's existing FastAPI, React, and operating-system keyring boundary.
candidates_considered: New provider registration endpoint in ADL

preconditions: ADL host UI and API are running
A supported operating-system credential store is available for API-key modes
steps: Reload state and inspect only public status
capability_demonstrations.observable: Provider forms and status through the UI, plus persisted registry metadata through the local API.
capability_demonstrations.expected_result: CLI registrations persist as configured_unverified, secrets are never returned, and Ollama remains operational.
limits: No Codex/GitHub/other new-provider live login or inference is claimed.
No UI path executes a provider CLI or starts an OAuth flow.
